decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction date of 'the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary' without specifying a location. The source documents describe four distinct churches with this name in different locations, each with a different construction date: 1) The church in Goa, India (D4S1) was built in 1544–1547. 2) The church in Alcamo, Italy has conflicting source data: Document 1 (D1S2) and Document 2 (D2S1/D2S2) state it was founded in 1660, while Document 3 (D3S1/D3S2) states it was founded in 1750. Since both dates are explicitly asserted in the provided texts for the same entity scope, both are retained as valid answers reflecting the source contradiction. 3) The church in Asmara, Eritrea (D5S2) was built in 1923. Other dates like 1587, 1510, 1866, 1927, and 1928 are incidental (referring to other events, previous residences, or different entities) and are excluded.
